title: My Dinosaur Friend
cast: Sam is a small boy about six years old, with short brown hair, a bright green t-shirt and blue shorts. The dinosaur is tiny — the size of a puppy — bright green with darker green polka dots, a round belly, short tail and big happy eyes. They are in a sunny back yard with a wooden fence, a big tree and flower beds.

p1.text: Sam found a little dinosaur. It had green polka dots. It blinked at him and smiled.
p1.art: Sam crouching in the grass, meeting the tiny polka-dotted dinosaur for the first time. Both look delighted.

a.text: Sam held out a big leaf. The dinosaur munched it up fast. Then he wanted more!
a.art: Sam holding out a big green leaf. The little dinosaur is chewing it happily, cheeks full.

b.text: Sam rolled a red ball. The dinosaur bopped it with his nose. The ball went flying!
b.art: The little dinosaur bopping a red ball with his nose, the ball flying up. Sam laughing behind him.

c.text: Sam showed him the whole yard. The dinosaur sniffed every flower. He sneezed a tiny sneeze.
c.art: The little dinosaur sniffing a flower bed and sneezing a tiny sneeze. Sam pointing things out.

a2.text: They picked leaves together all morning. The dinosaur made a happy hum. Sam hummed along too.
a2.art: Sam and the dinosaur gathering a pile of leaves together under the big tree, both humming happily.

b2.text: They played ball until lunchtime. The dinosaur was very good at it. He never dropped it once.
b2.art: Sam and the dinosaur mid-game with the red ball in the sunny yard, the dinosaur balancing it on his nose.

c2.text: The garden smelled very good. The dinosaur wagged his little tail. He liked the yard a lot.
c2.art: The little dinosaur wagging his tail among the flower beds, Sam kneeling beside him in the sunshine.

a2x.text: They ate crackers on the grass. The dinosaur liked cheese the best. Sam saved him the last one.
a2x.art: Sam and the dinosaur sitting on a picnic blanket on the grass sharing crackers and cheese.

a2y.text: They put a seed in the dirt. The dinosaur patted it down gently. Something green would grow soon.
a2y.art: Sam and the dinosaur planting a seed in a flower bed, the dinosaur patting the soil with one foot.

a2z.text: They lay under the big tree. The dinosaur curled up like a cat. Sam listened to him snore.
a2z.art: Sam lying in the shade under the big tree with the dinosaur curled up asleep beside him.

b2x.text: They played one last round. The dinosaur scored the winning goal. He did a happy little dance.
b2x.art: The little dinosaur doing a happy dance after scoring, the red ball behind him, Sam cheering.

b2y.text: They ran through the cold sprinkler. The dinosaur squeaked at every splash. His polka dots looked shiny.
b2y.art: Sam and the dinosaur running through a garden sprinkler, water sparkling, both soaked and delighted.

b2z.text: Mom brought out two cookies. The dinosaur ate his in one bite. Then he eyed Sam's cookie.
b2z.art: Sam holding a cookie on the back steps, the dinosaur licking his lips and eyeing it hopefully.

c2x.text: A fuzzy caterpillar crawled by. The dinosaur followed it very slowly. They watched it climb a leaf.
c2x.art: Sam and the dinosaur crouched low, watching a fuzzy caterpillar climb a leaf.

c2y.text: Sam picked a yellow flower. He put it behind the dinosaur's ear. The dinosaur felt very fancy.
c2y.art: Sam tucking a yellow flower behind the little dinosaur's ear. The dinosaur looks proud and pleased.

c2z.text: They stacked sticks into a tiny house. The dinosaur crawled inside to try it. It fit him just right.
c2z.art: A tiny house made of stacked sticks in the yard with the little dinosaur peeking out of the doorway, Sam grinning.
